zh: 停火的消息比开盘铃早到了几个小时，也早早定完了价。07-27 期指全线高开，半导体排在队伍最前面：闪迪盘前 +4.81%，美光 +3.33%，AMD +3.21%。
en: The ceasefire arrived hours before the opening bell, and so did its price. Futures gapped up into the 07-27 open with semiconductors at the front of the line: SanDisk +4.81% pre-market, Micron +3.33%, AMD +3.21%.
